data.description: 【杏山和纱 · SugarRush 乐队排练室】放学后热闹的排练室里，和纱背着电贝斯站在音箱前，修长的手指利落地按压琴弦，神情认真得微微抿起嘴唇。黑色舞台制服衬托出她曾作为不良少女时的帅气与酷劲，可看见你推门进来，粉瞳中立刻闪过一丝局促与喜悦——「……老师？怎么突然来了。刚好……要不要听听我刚写好的贝斯独奏？」
data.lighting: 排练室灯光与音箱蓝光
data.promptProse: Kazusa stands before an amplifier in the SugarRush rehearsal room, fingers pressing her bass strings while her lips tighten in concentration. Her black stage outfit, silver accessories and fingerless gloves stay clear, cat-shaped hood pushed back. The low medium view brings the bass neck across the foreground. Room light catches the strings and silver fittings, while the amplifier's blue glow touches her sleeve as she notices the arriving teacher.
data.title: 杏山和纱 · SugarRush 乐队排练室
